instruction: Fix `format_number` so it preserves the fractional part for non-integer values instead of truncating with int().
gold_patch:
diff --git a/rpncalc.py b/rpncalc.py
--- a/rpncalc.py
+++ b/rpncalc.py
@@ -60,4 +60,4 @@
 
 def format_number(value):
     """Format a number for display (drop a trailing '.0')."""
-    return str(int(value))
+    return str(int(value)) if value == int(value) else str(value)
